sql: select strategy, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) settled, round(sum(pnl) filter (where status='settled')::numeric,2) pnl, count(*) filter (where status='settled' and pnl<0) losers from paper_trades where strategy in ('Immsell10','Mmmsell10','Xmmsell10_pt4','Ymmsell10_pt4') and created_at >= '2026-11-10 04:07' group by 1 order by 1
